## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Lass es auf dich wirken** — [lahs ess owf deesh VEER-ken] — *Let it sink in / Let it affect you*
2. **Mir fällt ein Stein vom Herzen** — [meer felht ayn shtayn fom HAIR-tsen] — *A weight has been lifted off my shoulders*
3. **Ich bin ganz bei dir** — [eesh bin gahnts by deer] — *I'm fully with you / I completely agree*
